# Dropleads

Dropleads provides contact and company search, enrichment, email discovery, email verification, and mobile-number discovery APIs for sales workflows.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/dropleads/.

## Actions

- **Count Companies** (read-only): Count companies matching optional filters for free without returning company records or consuming credits.
- **Count People** (read-only): Count people matching optional filters without returning personal records or consuming credits.
- **Enrich Companies**: Enrich up to 50 companies by domain and/or name.
- **Enrich People with Verified Email**: Enrich 1-10 people and retrieve sensitive, unmasked personal records whose emails satisfy the requested verification policy.
- **Enrich People without Email Verification**: Enrich 1-10 people and return sensitive unmasked personal records without verifying returned emails.
- **Estimate lead export cost** (read-only): Get a free estimate only of credits required to save or export leads and whether the account can afford it.
- **Find Mobile Number**: Discover the sensitive personal mobile number associated with one LinkedIn profile URL.
- **Find Work Email**: Find and verify one person's sensitive work email from their name and company.
- **Get Credit Balance** (read-only): Return sensitive account subscription and pay-as-you-go credit balances and the configured credit rate.
- **Search Companies**: Return exactly one requested page of companies matching optional filters.
- **Search People** (read-only): Return exactly one requested page of masked people matching optional filters without consuming credits.
- **Verify Email**: Check one sensitive personal or business email address for valid, invalid, catch-all, or unknown deliverability.
